description: Shared state that agents read and write to cooperate without knowing about each other; from 1970s AI systems.
Each key or key pattern has one owner role allowed to write it. A permission boundary and an audit aid.
A write that succeeds only if the version it was based on is still current; otherwise it is rejected as a conflict.
A write built on stale data silently replacing a newer one. Long model calls make the window large.
An immutable, sequenced record of every write attempt. State is a replay of its accepted entries.
Detecting conflicts at write time instead of holding locks during the work; suited to slow writers such as agents.
